title: Technical Writer
description:
**Position:** Offsite Author – C\&F  
**Location:** Pune (Magarpatta)  
**Experience:** 1\+ Years Preferred  
**Education:** 4\-Year Engineering Degree / Equivalent

About the Role

We are looking for **Offsite Authors – C\&F** to support our client’s technical documentation requirements. The ideal candidate should have an **Engineering background along with training or knowledge in Technical Writing/Technical Communication**.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and maintain **technical documentation** related to construction and equipment systems.
* Develop clear and accurate documentation for **repair, maintenance, and diagnostic procedures**.
* Understand and document technical information related to **hydraulics, electrical, and powertrain systems**.
* Collaborate with technical teams and subject matter experts to gather and validate information.
* Ensure documentation meets required quality, accuracy, and formatting standards.

Required Skills

* 4\-year **Engineering degree or equivalent**.
* **1\+ years of relevant experience** preferred.
* Training or knowledge in **Technical Writing / Technical Communication**.
* Good understanding of technical concepts and documentation processes.
* Exposure to any of the following will be an advantage:
* Construction Equipment
* Repair \& Maintenance
* Diagnostics
* Hydraulics
* Electrical Systems
* Powertrain Systems
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to understand complex technical information.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with an **Engineering background and Technical Writing/Technical Communication training**, particularly those with exposure to construction equipment or related technical systems, are encouraged to apply.

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writer - Pharma & Medical
description:
Content Writer – Pharma \& Medical Domain

Location: Pune  
Experience: 4–6 Years

We are looking for an experienced **Content Writer** with strong knowledge of the **Pharma and Medical domain** to create accurate, engaging, and industry\-focused content.

Key Responsibilities:

* Create and edit **medical, pharmaceutical, and healthcare content**.
* Research and simplify complex medical/pharma information.
* Develop content for **websites, blogs, articles, reports, and marketing materials**.
* Ensure content is **accurate, clear, well\-researched, and grammatically correct**.
* Follow relevant **medical, pharmaceutical, and regulatory guidelines**.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and internal teams.

Key Skills:

* 4–6 years of experience in **Content Writing**, preferably in Pharma/Medical/Healthcare.
* Strong **research, writing, editing, and proofreading** skills.
* Good understanding of **pharmaceutical and medical terminology**.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to create **technical and audience\-friendly content**.
